FT: CEE Energy Giant Orlen Lost $424 Million in Venezuela Oil Deal Involving USDT Payments

Polish state-controlled energy giant Orlen lost an estimated $424 million through its Swiss trading arm OTS after a failed Venezuelan oil deal that involved USDT payments, the Financial Times reported.
